verdict.rationale: Bevy's primary 'scripting' language is Rust itself, and docs emphasize that ECS components/systems are just normal Rust structs and functions with no macros or special traits, giving full access to the engine API (bevy-docs-14, bevy-docs-20, bevy-docs-42, bevy-docs-43, bevy-docs-21). Community feedback corroborates ergonomics ('nice to work in Rust engine', 'elegant and clean') but also flags docs as thin and iteration friction with breaking changes (bevy-comm-14, bevy-comm-17, bevy-comm-10). However, there is no evidence in the pack of a dedicated debugger or debugging workflow tied to this scripting layer. Missing for 10: debugger/breakpoint tooling evidence, first-party debugging docs, and independent confirmation of full API coverage without gaps.
